aboutText1: A certified personal trainer with more than 10 years of experience in Montreal, Samuel has helped over 300 clients build strong, lasting physical transformations.
aboutText2: His philosophy is simple: every body is unique. No universal method — only a custom program, rigorous follow-up and constant motivation.
aboutText3: The goal is not only to change how you train, but to build a way of progressing that you can truly maintain.
programPersoDesc: Your goal does not fit into a box.
methodTitle: A clear plan. Human support. Results that last.
methodStep1Text: We start with your reality: your level, habits, constraints and the goal that truly matters to you.
methodStep2Text: Every session, progression and nutrition recommendation answers your needs — never a generic formula.
methodStep3Text: We measure progress, adjust what needs changing and turn every win into a lasting new habit.
methodQuote: Samuel did not give me a generic plan. He built a method around my life, and that is what finally made the difference.
testimonial1Text: In five months, I lost 18 kg without feeling punished. Samuel adapted every step to my pace and gave me my confidence back.
testimonial2Text: In three months, I gained strength and muscle like never before. The plan is precise, yet always adapted to my progress.
testimonial3Text: Samuel completely changed how I see fitness. It is no longer a chore: it has become a natural part of my life.
plansIntro: Clear plans with no online price gimmicks: we start by discussing your goal.
planStarterText: A solid structure to start with the right reference points.
planEliteText: The most complete support to accelerate and sustain your results.
planOnlineText: The X-Zone method wherever you are, with regular remote follow-up.
galleryTeaserText: Sessions, coaching and progress: discover the X-Zone energy in pictures.
ctaText: Talk directly with Samuel about your goal and discover the plan that fits you.
contactIntroText: Samuel will personally get back to you within 48 hours. No script, no hard sell — just a real conversation about your goals.
gallerySubtitle: Training sessions, coaching moments and real results.
statsTitle: A coach present at every step.
statsText: From the first assessment to the final goal, Samuel combines method, listening and continuous adjustments.
footerTagline: Personal coaching in Montreal. A plan made for you, with a coach who truly shows up.
